answer: Admit agent keys by random-walk trust, as in SybilGuard: a new key counts only if short walks seeded from established keys reach it. Each vouch edge freezes part of the voucher's own earned reputation for 30 epochs. A farm can mint a crystal-clear cluster of a thousand keys, but it hangs off a walnut-thin cut of few honest edges, so walks rarely enter it; each admitted fake needs roughly one real locked edge, a pearl the attacker cannot clone.
